description: Re-checks the audit 2026-05-23 Yekutieli natural-reading +0.5 finding at 50 dps. Confirms +0.5 is an exact rational (not a precision-floor artifact like meson Habiro c=4 was). The structural mismatch with Reading-A's −G is genuine. Open: which physical observable +0.5·h² actually contributes to.

data.verdict: AUDIT VERDICT STANDS — the natural-reading +0.5 result is exactly 1/2 at 50 dps (no precision-floor margin). The structural mismatch with Reading-A's −G ≈ −0.916 is genuine (sign opposite, magnitude factor 1.83×). This is NOT a meson-Habiro-style precision artifact: there's no truncation parameter that could absorb a sign flip. The +0.5 IS an exact rational arising from partition combinatorics ((1/4) · Σ_classes ((κ_λ + κ_λ^T)/2)); it just doesn't equal −G.
